def main():
 for name,want in EXPECTED.items():
  raw=INPUTS[name].encode();size,sha=want['files']['.txt']
  assert len(raw)==size and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==sha,name
  Path(name+'.txt').write_bytes(raw)
  if '--write-only' in sys.argv:continue
  with open(name+'.txt','rb') as i,open(name+'_AUDIT.json','wb') as o,open(name+'_AUDIT.log','wb') as e:
   subprocess.run(['./exact115'],stdin=i,stdout=o,stderr=e,check=True)
  r=json.loads(Path(name+'_AUDIT.json').read_text())
  for k,v in want.items():
   if k!='files':assert r[k]==v,(name,k)
  assert len(r['P'])==len(r['Q'])==1
  for suffix,(size,sha) in want['files'].items():
   raw=Path(name+suffix).read_bytes()
   assert len(raw)==size and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==sha,name+suffix
  print(name,'EXACT_FREEH_RECOVERY_PASS',[r[k] for k in ['V','E','F']],r['strict'],flush=True)
 print('J119_FREEH_FOUR_INPUT_HASHES_PASS' if '--write-only' in sys.argv else 'J119_FREEH_FOUR_OWN222_TWELVE_HASHES_PASS_NO_110',flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
